description: Evaluate the actual shared first-order syntax in a finite structure table by recursive connective evaluation and finite loops for quantifiers.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.evaluate (c : ℕ) (arities : List ℕ) {d : ℕ}
  (T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.Table c arities d) {n : ℕ} :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.lang c arities).BoundedFormula Empty n →
    (Fin n → Fin (d + 1)) → Bool
